packageRules.description: Non-major, non-0.x dependencies: grouped, and NOT auto-merged. Automerge here was only ever safe because typecheck/lint/test/migration-test/gitleaks/license-gate/trivy/compose-hardening all block on the same PR (D14) — and the Phase 0 security gate found three of those gates broken at once: compose-hardening passed a maximally hostile service (H-1), the license gate failed on a wall-clock date diff rather than a real change (M-6), and gitleaks was red at HEAD. A merge queue is exactly as trustworthy as the checks in front of it, so automerge stays false until a green run of `just verify` is the norm rather than the exception. Re-enable in the same PR that can point at a sustained green pipeline.
Major bumps and anything still at 0.x always need a human.
0.x packages have no SemVer guarantee — never auto-merge, regardless of update type.
Docker base images: digest-pinned everywhere already (D13); Renovate proposes the digest bump, never a floating tag.
GitHub Actions: same digest-pinning policy as Docker images — every action in .github/workflows/*.yml is pinned to a commit SHA, never a tag (06 §5.1).
Node is pinned to the 26.x line (D1) until a deliberate LTS-line decision.
Postgres major-version bumps are a dump/restore project, not a Renovate PR (D2).
The pnpm version pinned in package.json's packageManager field and CI's `npm install --global pnpm@...` line move together, deliberately, not on Renovate's schedule.
